turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Good morning! I'm Maya. What's your name?
turns.style: Warm first greeting; natural A1 pace.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Hi, Maya! My name is Leo. It's my first English class.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Pretty good, thanks. I'm feeling excited. And you?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Really good, thank you. I like meeting new people.
turns.style: Warm and confident, no exaggerated emphasis.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I'm excited, but I'm a little afraid, too.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: That's okay. You're not alone. The people here are friendly.
turns.style: Reassuring, one clear thought at a time.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: The teacher says, 'Introduce yourself.' What can I say?
turns.style: Curious; quote the classroom instruction clearly.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Start with your name. Then show something you like.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Like this photograph? It's my cat. Its name is Coco.
turns.style: Shows photograph; articulate its versus it's naturally.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Coco looks sad in this photograph.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: No, Coco isn't sad. Coco is tired.
turns.style: Clear corrective contrast; not a grammar chant.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Oh, I see. Is everything okay?

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Yes, nothing is wrong. But can I ask for advice?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Of course. Just say hello and smile.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Thank you! I'm not afraid now. I'm feeling really good.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Great! See you in class, Leo!
